response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM ev GROUP BY type) SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM t) AS ratio_to_mean FROM t
